name: assisted seated pectoralis major stretch with stability ball
description: A partner-assisted seated pectoral stretch with a stability ball supporting the upper back.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a stability ball and your feet planted.
Place your hands behind your head or let your elbows open comfortably.
Have a partner support your upper body and gently guide your elbows back to open the chest.
Breathe steadily, hold a comfortable stretch briefly, then have your partner release the pressure slowly.
